name: Stremio
author: Korie
description: Each person signs in with their own Stremio account. Their Stremio add-ons put films and series in their Films and Series, Search asks them, and what they watch in Korie shows up in Stremio's Continue Watching too, and the other way round. Streams play when an add-on gives a web address; add-ons that only give torrents can't be played.

accounts.label: Stremio account
accounts.help: Korie keeps only Stremio's sign-in key, never the password.
